rules.statement: A procedural sentence states one instruction.
A procedural sentence does not exceed the declared word budget.
A descriptive sentence does not exceed the declared word budget.
An instruction uses the active voice and the imperative.
A word carries one approved meaning within one document.
A Technical Name or Technical Verb is used only if the project termbase admits it.
A warning or caution precedes the step it applies to.
